title: SalesReportService.generate — F-011 dual-payload orchestration
scope: M-005 use case. Single class SalesReportService with one public method generate(date_from, date_to, dealer_ids, places, design_ids) → SalesReportResponse. Builds Consolidation (GROUP BY design+grade) + Transactions (per-line) from sales_header + sales_line + designs + grades + dealers joins. Both queries share a SINGLE filter-predicate builder (DS-017) — guarantees AC-050 reconciliation by construction. Defense-in-depth: service asserts sum(transactions.nos) == sum(consolidation.total_nos) before return.

success_criteria.manual: Seed 3 dealers × 2 designs × 2 grades × 10 sales across June 2026. generate(date_from=2026-06-01, date_to=2026-06-30) → consolidation rows grouped by (design, grade) with correct SUMs; transactions rows ordered by (sales_date, header_id). sum(transactions.nos) == sum(consolidation.total_nos).
success_criteria.automated: All 14 TCs pass (TC-157 perf gate over the same workload as TC-122).
success_criteria.definition_of_done: Single class, single public method. Filter predicate built ONCE (private helper) and applied to both queries — no duplicated WHERE clauses. AC-050 assertion present and raises if violated. RULE-019 sort on consolidation, RULE-020 sort on transactions enforced in SQL.

checkout_prompt: SalesReportService.generate implemented. Shared filter predicate guarantees AC-050 by construction; defense-in-depth assertion present. Ready for router wiring in T-065.
